enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Move legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Lie still.

Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and food. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit down. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office. Clock in.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at clinic. Put on lab coat. Turn on computer. Log in. Check patient list. Call patient. Escort to exam room. Measure vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to reception. Schedule appointment. Return to desk. Type notes. Answer phone. Eat lunch. See more patients. Update records. Clock out.
Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up dishes. Walk to sink. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.

Enter bedroom. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Move legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Lie still.
